parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The resource ID. Set this parameter to a live streaming domain name.
Valid values of N: **1 to 50**.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set this parameter to **DOMAIN**.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The label key. Valid values of N: **1 to 20**.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The label value. Valid values of N: **1 to 20**.
